_doc: Class outfits for classes that exist ONLY in Thousandvale (wrap-up 2026-10-13, Y32: the Starcaller). The shared tables avatar-3d/data/class-outfits.json and class-outfits-t2.json belong to Farhold and Emberveil as well and are not written (a test there counts thirty tier-2 rows); js/client/looks.js lays THIS file over them in memory. Same shapes as the shared files: `classes` = the tier-1 outfit (the title preview and the creation card: hat, top, bottom, shoes, cape, decor, held, offhand), `tier2` = the tier-2 outfit (avatar-3d/js/class-outfits.js tier2Dress: themed and high-level armour takes its trim, emblem and decor kit from it). `wear` is Thousandvale's own: in the world a character wears exactly its gear (gear-look.js), and `wear[cls].cloth` says how THIS class's plain cloth pieces are cut and coloured (part by part: head -> hat, chest -> top, legs -> bottom, feet -> shoes) so a Starcaller in its starter robes is midnight and gold rather than the grey every cloth robe is. The worn head piece is a HOOD (the item is called a Hood, and a thing must look like its name — W25); the pointed hat is the portrait's. Only cloth pieces change, and only for that class; an item with its own model (item.look.worn) keeps it. Every part id is one the shared avatar-2d normaliser knows; `emblem` is a chibi2-armour2.js emblem (the star).
